summary: Resolved the three pre-push defects with scoped edits: learning writeback helpers now no-op cleanly on cold schemas, migration 0039 now guards repair-index creation for direct sqlite3 application, and source-completeness preserves missing entries with spaces and unicode as single JSON array items.

fixes.description: mo_learning_update_conductor_outcomes now catches sqlite3.OperationalError from missing learning tables, prints 0, and exits successfully while leaving the normal update/commit/count path unchanged.

mo_learning_write_grpo_advantages now treats an absent relative_advantage column or missing execution_traces table as optional cold-schema writeback, printing 0 and exiting successfully without masking non-OperationalError failures.
The migration header now documents the self-guarded direct-application contract, and the two repair index statements are generated only when their backing columns exist.
The failing-path missing array is passed to Python as argv elements and serialized with json.dumps(sys.argv[1:]), preserving entries containing spaces and unicode.

verification: Cold scratch DB helper probe: mo_learning_update_conductor_outcomes and mo_learning_write_grpo_advantages each printed 0 and exited 0.
Direct sqlite3 migration probe with absent target columns exited 0 and created no repair indexes.
Direct sqlite3 migration probe with present target columns exited 0 and created idx_execution_traces_process_reward_repair and idx_agent_perf_advantage_repair.
source-completeness failing-path probe parsed valid JSON and preserved 'lens-glm.md (only 0 sources, need ≥5)' as one missing array element.
